traits.name: Unbound
traits.effect: - Increase DMG by 350%; - Decrease SPA by 5%; - Increase Range by 10%; Single Placement
traits.restriction: Single placement: compare total team output before rerolling.
traits.why: The documented 350% damage amplification concentrates output into a single placement. Compare that one carry with the total output and coverage of the placements it replaces; it is not an automatic support or economy recommendation.
traits.status: Current source reviewed; tier and Best For are TierListBase editorial.

traits.name: Primordial
traits.effect: - Increase DMG by 35%; - Decrease SPA by 15%; - Increase Range by 20%
traits.restriction: Role fit and actual unit mechanics determine value.
traits.why: Damage, attack interval and range improve together without the documented single-placement restriction of Unbound. This gives damage units a broad alternative when multiple placements matter.
traits.status: Current source reviewed; tier and Best For are TierListBase editorial.

traits.name: Forsaken
traits.effect: - Increase Crit DMG by 35%; - Increase Crit Chance by 35%; - Increase Range by 10%
traits.restriction: Role fit and actual unit mechanics determine value.
traits.why: Critical chance and critical damage improve together. Value depends on the unit actually using critical attacks and its existing critical stats; a non-critical support kit does not gain the same benefit.
traits.status: Current source reviewed; tier and Best For are TierListBase editorial.

traits.name: Draconic
traits.effect: - Increase DMG by 20%; - Increase DoT Damage by 120%; - Decrease overall cost by 15%
traits.restriction: Role fit and actual unit mechanics determine value.
traits.why: The large documented DoT bonus rewards a damaging status kit, while the cost reduction helps establish it earlier. A direct-hit unit without damaging DoT does not use the main reason for this grade.
traits.status: Current source reviewed; dated Update 3 buff conflict resolved; tier is TierListBase editorial.

traits.name: Investor
traits.restriction: Role fit and actual unit mechanics determine value.
traits.why: The income increase addresses the economy slot rather than carry damage. Its value depends on bringing a money-farm unit and having enough remaining upgrades or waves to spend the extra income.
traits.status: Current source reviewed; tier and Best For are TierListBase editorial.

traits.name: Optics
traits.restriction: Role fit and actual unit mechanics determine value.
traits.why: Extra range can expand support coverage and keep more targets within a conditional aura. It does not supply direct damage or attack-speed bonuses, so evaluate actual map coverage before choosing it for a carry.

traits.name: Bolt
traits.restriction: Role fit and actual unit mechanics determine value.
